text:
I've visited this clinic 3 times, and both the male and female doctors provided accurate and high-quality treatment. Although the clinic may not be as modern as many others nowadays, they effectively solved my problems.
(I received services including teeth cleaning, fillings, and they helped me find the cause of my tooth pain from a filling I had done elsewhere)...Thank you very much!

My father had a dental appointment at 11:00 AM. When he arrived, there was already a new appointment, so he canceled. He then went to another clinic, but they said the old clinic had revoked his treatment rights and therefore they couldn't cancel it. He called the old clinic to have the cancellation done, but the staff there said it had already been cancelled. However, the staff at the new clinic couldn't verify the cancellation. It seems they're essentially revoking his rights even though he didn't receive any treatment. This is unacceptable. If we hadn't gone to the other clinic, we wouldn't have known they revoked his rights for no reason. How can people be taken advantage of like this if they're unaware? This is terrible.
I had a tooth filled and now I have a toothache when exposed to cold or hot water. I had it checked again and they told me to go to Chula. That's amazing!
